title: ZED Agent Service Configuration
description: Normalized configuration schema for ZED Agent multi-service release automation (v1.0).

$schema.description: Pointer to this schema file for editor validation.

service.description: Identity metadata for the service being released.

description.description: Brief description of the service release purpose.

stampTag.description: Per-service stamp-name infix used to filter inventory rows to THIS service. Stamps follow the grammar `{shortName}-{layout}-{stampTag}{index}` (e.g. 'eus-pod01-prot1', 'eus-pod01-rec2'). Consumed by Get-StampInventory.ps1 to filter Kusto results and validate canary stamp names. Lowercase, letters only.

serviceTreeIds.description: Service Tree GUIDs used by SafeFly and EV2.

safefly.description: Service Tree GUID for SafeFly registration.

ev2.description: Service Tree GUIDs keyed by EV2 environment (Prod, Fairfax, Mooncake, etc.).

ado.description: Azure DevOps coordinates for the source repository.

baseBranch.description: Base branch from which release branches are cut.

releaseMode.description: 'cut-branch' (default): Step 2 cuts <branchPrefix><YYMM> from baseBranch and the release deploys that branch. 'deploy-base' (e.g. BCM): no release branch — the release deploys the base branch itself (owner confirms the deployment branch at setup, default baseBranch). The release is the build of the newest deployable commit of that branch (Step 2), the previous release is the build the last production rollout deployed, and EVERY canary/production/rollback run is pinned to its exact build (requires pipeline-catalog artifactFeed + buildResource). Step 16 (merge-back) is skipped. Script: scripts/Resolve-ReleaseBuild.ps1.

integration.description: Optional pre-branch-cut Reverse/Forward Integration (Step 2 sub-phases 2a/2b) for services that keep a develop + master pair. 2a RI: merge mainBranch into developBranch via PR, wait for merge, then wait for the release owner's `approve-ri`. 2b FI: merge developBranch into mainBranch via PR, wait for merge. 2c: the normal branch cut from ado.baseBranch. Absent or enabled=false keeps the stock Step 2.

mainBranch.description: Release-source branch (RI source, FI target). Must equal ado.baseBranch so the release branch is cut from the FI result.

preservePaths.description: Repo-relative paths whose PR-TARGET version always wins (RI keeps develop's, FI keeps master's). Applies to conflicted and cleanly-merged files.

conflictStrategy.description: How conflicts outside preservePaths are resolved. 'newest-commit-per-file': the branch whose last commit touching the file is newer wins the conflicting hunks (ties keep the target).

riBranchTemplate.description: Name of the RI integration branch. Tokens: {releaseId} (e.g. 2026-11), {releaseTag} (leaf of release.currentBranch, e.g. bcm-2611).

fiBranchTemplate.description: Name of the FI integration branch. Same tokens as riBranchTemplate.

requireGoAheadAfterRI.description: After the RI PR merges, halt Step 2 in waiting-approval until the release owner sends `approve-ri`. FI then starts automatically.

prPollIntervalSeconds.description: Watcher poll interval for the RI/FI PR status (poll-ado-pr).

kusto.description: Kusto query configuration for BVT and canary monitoring.

bvt.description: BVT (Build Verification Test) Kusto query settings.

queryFile.description: Filename of the KQL query template.

queryVariables.description: Key-value pairs substituted into the KQL query template.

canary.description: Canary cluster-type detection Kusto query settings. Consumed by Resolve-PipelinesByClusterType.ps1 (-Scope canary) when pipeline-catalog.json → canaryRouting.mode == 'cluster-type'.

queryFile.description: Filename (relative to .github/skills/zed-agent/queries/) of the canary cluster-type detection KQL query.

serviceFilter.description: KQL where-clause fragment substituted into {{SERVICE_FILTER}}. May be empty when scopingNotes records that the query is pre-scoped.

stampPrefixFilter.description: List of stamp-name prefixes joined into a `StampName startswith '<p1>' or …` predicate and substituted into {{STAMP_PREFIX_FILTER}}.

clusterTypeExtraction.description: How Resolve-PipelinesByClusterType.ps1 extracts the live cluster-type set from result rows.

column.description: Required when mode='column' — name of the result column holding the cluster type.

scopingNotes.description: Free-text memo describing how the query scopes to the service when serviceFilter is empty.

production.description: Production cluster-type detection Kusto query settings. Consumed by Resolve-PipelinesByClusterType.ps1 (-Scope production) when pipeline-catalog.json → productionRouting.mode == 'cluster-type' (Step 10 and Step 15). Shape mirrors the canary block exactly — cluster type is a pipeline-level attribute, so the resolver runs once per release (not per cloud) and each resolved pipeline pushes to whichever clouds are listed under ev2CloudCoverage.<key>.

queryFile.description: Filename (relative to .github/skills/zed-agent/queries/) of the production cluster-type detection KQL query. Must declare {{SERVICE_FILTER}} and {{STAMP_PREFIX_FILTER}} placeholders (same shape as canary).

serviceFilter.description: KQL where-clause fragment substituted into {{SERVICE_FILTER}}. May be empty when scopingNotes records that the query is pre-scoped.

stampPrefixFilter.description: List of stamp-name prefixes joined into a `StampName startswith '<p1>' or …` predicate and substituted into {{STAMP_PREFIX_FILTER}}. Auto-derived by setup-service group 11.3a from the distinct lower-cased ShortName values under AzureServiceConfig.json → Clouds[Public].DataCenters[] — covers Public-cloud stamps only. Sovereign clouds (Fairfax/Mooncake/USNat/USSec) require AME-tenant Kusto and are handled out-of-band. Owners may hand-edit this list any time; the wizard will not overwrite a non-empty value on re-run.

clusterTypeExtraction.description: How Resolve-PipelinesByClusterType.ps1 extracts the live cluster-type set from result rows.

revertBits.description: Optional revert bits, built as a Step 7 pre-phase right after the canary BVT sign-off (approve-bvt): <branchTemplate> is forked from the PREVIOUS release commit and, through a PR, receives only the settings the release owner chooses to keep from THIS release (preserveAlways keys are always kept). ZED then builds it, waits for the owner's BVT sign-off (approve-revert), and — when useForRollback — Step 7 rolls canary back with that build instead of release.previousBranch. Script: scripts/Invoke-RevertBits.ps1.

branchTemplate.description: Revert branch name. Tokens: {{YYMM}}, {{releaseId}}, {{releaseTag}} (leaf of release.currentBranch). BCM: releases/bcm{{YYMM}}revert.

topicBranchTemplate.description: Work branch that carries the kept settings; the PR goes from here into the revert branch. Extra token: {ownerAlias}.

files.description: Repo-relative settings files to compare (every '.../Properties' object: defaults, per cloud, per stamp).

preserveAlways.description: Setting keys always kept from this release when they changed (any scope), e.g. 'BCMAppConfig->BCMTeeWorkflowVersion'.

useForRollback.description: Step 7 deploys the revert build (ArtifactsBranch = revert branch) instead of release.previousBranch.

commitExcel.description: Settings for the commit-collection Excel sheet.

mode.description: 'per-release': Step 4 creates and uploads a new commits.xlsx every release (default). 'tracker': Step 4 adds one sheet per release to a single shared workbook (commitExcel.tracker) and edits it in place via the Graph Excel API — scripts/Invoke-CommitTracker.ps1.

tracker.description: Required when mode == 'tracker'. The shared workbook and its column layout.

url.description: SharePoint sharing link (or URL) of the shared tracker workbook.

dateFormat.description: Excel number format of the date column.

headerStyle.description: Header row styling for sheets ZED creates.

columns.description: Columns in sheet order. Exactly one column must have source 'link' (or 'linkText') — it identifies each row (PR id / commit sha). Columns without a source are team-filled; 'required: true' ones must be non-empty on every row before Step 4 completes.

width.description: Column width (points) for sheets ZED creates.

aliases.description: Other header spellings accepted when adopting an existing sheet (matching ignores spaces and case).

sheetNameTemplate.description: Template for the Excel sheet tab name. Supports {{YYMM}} placeholder.

sharePointFolder.description: SharePoint document library path for uploading the Excel file.

excludeAuthors.description: Git author names to exclude from commit collection.

sharepoint.description: SharePoint site configuration for commit Excel uploads.

sitePath.description: SharePoint site path for Graph API (e.g., '/teams/AzureBackupDataPlane').

groups.description: Named recipient groups referenced by routing rules.

teamsExtended.description: Extended Teams channel names (used for commit-request and similar broader broadcasts).

routing.description: Per-step notification routing. Keys are step identifiers (matching stepGates: '1-send-reminder' through '16-merge-back'), plus 'approval-requests' for pipeline runs waiting on the OneBranch Approval Service / an ADO approval (approval-needed/-reminder/-expiring -> halt, approval-failed -> failure; Invoke-ApprovalWatch.ps1). Each step may define routing for any of three outcomes: 'success', 'failure', 'halt' (where 'halt' covers both unexpected halts and approval-waiting gates). The release owner is ALWAYS added to every notification by Resolve-NotificationRecipients.ps1 — there is no per-rule includeOwner field. Any step or outcome not listed defaults to owner-only. EventKeys map into this table as follows: step-<N>-completed/skipped -> success; step-<N>-failed -> failure; step-<N>-waiting-approval -> halt; reminder -> 1-send-reminder.success; commit-request -> 4-collect-commits.success; create-r2d -> 13-create-r2d.success; ev2-stage-progress -> 15-production-rollout.success; ev2-promotion-reminder -> 15-production-rollout.halt. Generic keys (judgment, failure, halt, step-transition) are unmapped and always owner-only.

_comment.description: Human-readable comment explaining the routing section.

titleTemplate.description: Template for SafeFly CR title. Supports {serviceName}, {serviceDisplayName}, {month}, {yy} placeholders.

descriptionTemplate.description: Template for SafeFly CR description. Supports {serviceName}, {releaseId} placeholders.

tags.description: Tags applied to the SafeFly change request.

additionalNotifiers.description: Extra email addresses to notify on SafeFly CR events.

monitoringLink.description: Monitoring dashboard URL (e.g., Geneva MDM monitors link).

serviceGroupName.description: SafeFly DeploymentToolInputs ServiceGroupName — the service's registered EV2/SafeFly deployment-tool service group (e.g. 'Backup (MAB)'). Service-specific; ZED reads this from config and must never hard-code it.

regions.description: Region source-of-truth for deployment/SafeFly region discovery (consumed by Get-RegionMapping.ps1). Service-specific; ZED reads these instead of hard-coding a region source.

ascRepo.description: ADO repo (in msazure/One) holding the AzureServiceConfig.json region source-of-truth.

ascBranch.description: Branch of ascRepo to fetch from (e.g. 'develop').

supplementaryRegions.description: SafeFly-only regions without physical deployment stamps, not yet in ASC. Each item: { DataCenterName, RegionShortName }.

operational.description: Timeouts, polling intervals, and operational parameters.

buildTimeoutMinutes.description: Maximum minutes to wait for a build to complete. Default 360 (6 hours).

bvtWaitHours.description: Hours to wait before running BVT queries after deployment.

bvtQueryTimeoutMinutes.description: Maximum minutes for a BVT Kusto query to return results.

excelCompletionTimeoutHours.description: Maximum hours to wait for commit Excel completion.

canaryBakeTimeHours.description: Hours to bake in canary before progressing.

reminderBeforeCutDays.description: Days before branch cut date to send the reminder.

approvalPollIntervalSeconds.description: How often the watcher checks watched pipeline runs for pending approvals (Approval Service / ADO), independent of watcherPollIntervalSeconds.

approvalReminderHours.description: Re-send the approval email + Teams message every N hours while the approval is still pending (0 = no reminders).

approvalExpiryWarnHours.description: Send one 'approval expires soon' alert this many hours before the OneBranch approval task expires.

watcherPollIntervalSeconds.description: Seconds between watcher poll cycles in production mode.

watcherTestModePollIntervalSeconds.description: Seconds between watcher poll cycles in test mode.

watcherMaxRetries.description: Maximum consecutive retries for transient watcher failures.

regionMappingRepo.description: ADO repository containing AzureServiceConfig.json for region mapping.

regionMappingPath.description: File path within the region mapping repo.

regionMappingBranch.description: Branch to read region mapping from.

stepGates.description: Per-step approval gates. true = owner must approve before next step. false = auto-advance.

_comment.description: Human-readable comment explaining the stepGates section.

sds.description: Service Datacenter Settings (Phobos 2022 schema, https://aka.ms/phobosweb/schema/2022/sds) location, keyed by pipeline key from pipeline-catalog.json. Populated by setup-service group 11.3b after the owner confirms the file the wizard located by following the pipeline YAML's `-SdsFiles <name>` hint. Consumed by Get-StampInventory.ps1 (SDS reconciliation for Public cloud, SDS-only inventory for sovereign clouds) and the inventory approval gate. Multiple pipeline keys may point at the same SDS file when one repo backs many pipelines.

repo.description: ADO repository name that hosts the SDS file (e.g. 'Mgmt-RecoverySvcs-DataMover').

branch.description: Branch on which the SDS file is authoritative (matches the pipeline YAML's `resources.repositories` ref).

path.description: Path within the repo, ending in the filename (e.g. 'src/ServiceFabric/Deployment/ServiceDatacenterSettingsConfig.json').

fileName.description: Bare filename as referenced by the pipeline's `-SdsFiles <name>` argument (e.g. 'ServiceDatacenterSettingsConfig.json' or 'ServiceDatacenterSettingsConfigActPass.json').

confirmedAt.description: UTC timestamp when the owner confirmed (via setup-service group 11.3b) that this is the SDS that contains all stamps for this service.

confirmedBy.description: Email/UPN of the owner who confirmed the SDS location.

localClonePath.description: Optional absolute path to a local clone of `repo`. When present, Get-StampInventory.ps1 reads the SDS from disk instead of fetching from ADO — faster and works offline.

sdsFieldMapping.description: Overrides the Phobos 2022 default dotted paths Get-StampInventoryFromSds.ps1 walks when parsing the SDS. Built-in defaults match the schema at https://aka.ms/phobosweb/schema/2022/sds. Set this block only when the service's SDS uses a non-standard shape; setup-service group 11.3b detects the shape and writes the override once with owner confirmation. Any subset of keys may be supplied — missing keys fall back to the built-in defaults.

cloudArrayPath.description: Dotted path from SDS root to the array of cloud entries. Default 'CloudSettings'.

cloudNameField.description: Field on each cloud entry that holds its name (e.g. 'Public', 'Canary', 'Fairfax'). Default 'CloudName'.

stampsArrayField.description: Field on each cloud entry that holds the array of stamps. Default 'StampSettings'.

stampIdField.description: Field on each stamp entry holding the canonical stamp id (e.g. 'ea-01'). Default 'StampId'.

stampNamePath.description: Dotted path from a stamp entry to the full stamp name (e.g. 'ea-can02-dm1'). Default 'Macros.__StampName__'.

inventory.description: Stamp/region inventory overrides. Populated by setup-service. The production inventory is live-queried from Kusto by Get-StampInventory.ps1 and (when sds is configured) cross-checked against SDS; the canary inventory is owner-curated here (canary set is small and stable — one DC in the Canary cloud, today). Sovereign clouds (Fairfax/Mooncake/USNat/USSec) are sourced from SDS only — Get-StampInventory.ps1 refuses Kusto for them because AME-tenant access is unavailable from setup-service.

driftToleranceCount.description: Maximum number of unmatched stamps (Kusto-only or SDS-only) tolerated before Get-StampInventory.ps1 marks the run as 'drift' and the inventory approval gate refuses Step 10 / Step 15. 0 means any drift requires re-approval.

approvalRequired.description: When true (default), readiness.inventory.approved must be true AND readiness.inventory.sds.hash must match the latest SDS hash before Step 10 (Roll-Forward) and Step 15 (Production Rollout) are allowed to fire.

canary.description: Owner-curated canary stamp inventory. Multi-cloud: each stamp carries its own cloud / region / layout so services whose canary stamps span Public + sovereign clouds (or live entirely in Public, e.g. 'ecy', 'ccy') are represented natively. Get-StampInventory.ps1 (-Scope canary) reads this block instead of enumerating ASC datacenters, and lazily resolves clusterType via the Kusto query collected in Phase 4b when entries have clusterType=null and canaryRouting.mode == 'cluster-type'.

cloud.description: DEPRECATED single-cloud cloud Name. Kept only so older configs still load; new fields live on each stamp. New configs should omit.

layout.description: DEPRECATED single-cloud Layout. Kept only so older configs still load; new fields live on each stamp.

regions.description: DEPRECATED single-cloud regions list. Kept only so older configs still load; new fields live on each stamp.

regionPrefixHints.description: Owner-declared canary region short names (or shape-anchored prefixes like 'ea-can') from setup-service Group 4c. The wizard looks each one up in AzureServiceConfig.json to resolve its cloud + layout, then builds the stamps[] entries below. Persisted only so re-runs of Group 4c can offer the saved list as a default; not consulted by Get-StampInventory at release time.

stamps.description: Canary stamps for this service across all clouds. Each entry carries its own cloud / region / layout so the agent does not assume a single canary cloud. clusterType may be null at setup time — Get-StampInventory.ps1 fills it lazily via the Phase 4b Kusto query when canaryRouting.mode == 'cluster-type'.

stampName.description: Full stamp identifier as it appears in Kusto / EV2 (e.g. 'ea-can02-prot1', 'ecy-prod-prot1').

cloud.description: Cloud Name from AzureServiceConfig.json → Clouds[].Name (e.g. 'Public', 'Canary', 'BVTD3'). Optional for back-compat — when omitted, falls back to inventory.canary.cloud (deprecated singular).

region.description: DataCenter ShortName from ASC (e.g. 'ea', 'ecy', 'ccy'). Optional for back-compat — when omitted, derived from stampName prefix.

layout.description: Cloud Layout (stamp-name middle segment) for this stamp's cloud (e.g. 'can02', 'prod'). Optional for back-compat — when omitted, falls back to inventory.canary.layout (deprecated singular).

clusterType.description: Cluster type token consumed by pipeline-catalog.json → canaryRouting.clusterTypeMap (e.g. 'sfrp', 'sfmc', 'eap', 'aks'). May be null at setup time — Get-StampInventory.ps1 fills it lazily by running kusto.canary when canaryRouting.mode == 'cluster-type'. setup-service Group 4c never prompts for this value.

stampId.description: Short stamp identifier expected by pipelines that use ParseStampId (e.g. 'ea-01', 'ecy-01'). When present, Resolve-TemplateParams.ps1 uses this for {{canaryStamps}} / {{*Stamps}} tokens by default (stampNameStyle='short'). When absent, falls back to stampName.

ccoaExclusions.description: CCOA (Change Control / Operational Awareness) exclusions for the current release cycle. Stamps listed here are subtracted from all emitted {{*Stamps}} tokens and populate {{excludeStamps}}. Regions listed here are subtracted from all emitted {{*Regions}} tokens. Populated by setup-service or manually by the release owner before Step 15.

stamps.description: Stamp IDs excluded from production deployment (e.g. ['isc-01', 'ne5s-01']). These populate {{excludeStamps}} and are subtracted from all {{*Stamps}} tokens.

regions.description: Region names excluded from production deployment (e.g. ['indiasouthcentral', 'northeastus5']). These are subtracted from all {{*Regions}} tokens. A region should be listed here when ALL its stamps are excluded.

agentFeedbackEmail.description: Email address that receives feedback about the ZED agent itself. Hardcoded to the agent author; do not change.

stampPrefixToRegion.description: Optional service-specific map from a stamp-name PREFIX to its Azure region short name, e.g. { "isc": "indiasouthcentral", "ne5s": "northeastus5", "uae": "uaecentral", "ilc": "israelcentral", "qac": "qatarcentral" }. Stamps are named {prefix}-{layout}-{serviceTag}{n} and the prefix is NOT always the literal region code (e.g. 'uae' maps to uaecentral via short code 'uac'). Steps that add a stamp's region to a pipeline's PubRegions (onboarding/reclassifying a stamp) look the region up here instead of guessing. Service-agnostic — each service supplies its own map.
